text: Under the entry headed Ives Hill, the register identifies Amadou Keita as the caller and Alina Voron as the recipient.
A member of Sablewood Insurance told the clerk that Alina Voron and Amadou Keita used different entrances.
The statement uses Voron for Alina Voron throughout. It mentions a stop at Ives Hill on the last page.
The message reached Amadou Keita after noon. Its sender, Alina Voron, was using an account at Sablewood Insurance.
Two witnesses give different accounts of whether Amadou Keita spoke to Alina Voron in Ives Hill.
The receiving officer put Sablewood Insurance on the delivery label. The package had previously been signed for by Alina Voron in Ives Hill.
